modelingNotes: Manufacturer identifies 29329 as a set of 6 phase separators / interphase barriers for fixed-mounted ComPact NS100/160/250 circuit breakers. Compact NS Catalogue (illustration ref E18606) lists 'Interphase barriers, Set of 6, 29329' on the NS100/160/250 accessories page and in the NS100-250 column of the Barriers cross-reference (NS400-630 = 32570).

Purely mechanical / dielectric accessory. Interphase barriers reinforce phase-to-phase and phase-to-earth insulation (creepage/clearance) at the breaker power terminals. They have zero electrical terminals, conductors or circuit functions; they only insulate and never terminate, bond or join any net.

No electrical rating is assigned. Any application voltage in Schneider literature describes the insulation-reinforcement condition, not a switching/supply rating of the barrier; nominal_voltage is intentionally omitted.
The MGE. prefix reflects Merlin Gerin legacy numbering.
Replaced by ComPacT NSX 100/160/250 interphase barriers LV429329 (set of 6). Do not substitute the NSX/successor order number for this exact NS order.

connectionCoverage.notes: Mechanical interphase-barrier set (6 pieces); no electrical terminals, conductors or circuit functions. Fit and insulation reinforcement depend on the specified ComPact NS100/160/250 breaker and its connection arrangement; host-breaker terminals and enclosure bonding are separate parts.
